'''2013 Worlds Day 2 Nathan Wall LS The Hyperdrive Generator's Gone''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Nathan Wall]] at [[2013 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Name as written on the Day 2 sheet.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|The Hyperdrive Generator's Gone / We'll Need A New One|Cor-L-thehyperdrivegeneratorsgone.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
